conda_quick_start.environment: Fresh temporary Conda prefix with python=3.12, pip and git; environment-scoped PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 excludes unrelated user-site packages.
conda_quick_start.dependency_check: python -m pip check: no broken requirements
conda_quick_start.scope: Client/grader setup only; optional GPU serving dependencies not installed, no model or benchmark executed. Existing environments were not modified.

gold_validation.criterion: Gold patch applied; complete test-output markers; all FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests parsed as PASSED; nonempty FAIL_TO_PASS set.
gold_validation.runtime: Local Docker; 4 CPUs and 32 GiB RAM per container; up to 4 primary workers plus 2 targeted retry workers; 1800-second test timeout; no GPU device requests.
grading_fixes: Drain subprocess stdout/stderr concurrently; bound inherited open pipes after process exit. Tokio 4867 failed with an empty captured log before the fix and passed after retry.
Preserve gold-patch context whitespace and the terminal newline. Bat 1892 had a corrupt normalized patch before the fix and passed after retry.
gold_validation.new_image_cleanup: Remove only newly pulled image tags when no container references them; preserve pre-existing images and unrelated tasks.
gold_validation.scope: Gold grading-chain validation only; no new model accuracy measurements or recursive search cycles.

prompt_migration.agent_template_source: Pinned mini-swe-agent 2.4.2 swebench.yaml; built-in agent templates now load from si2ca/prompts while retaining existing non-prompt runtime defaults and explicit template overrides.
prompt_migration.scope: Coding-agent instructions, tool schema, self-judgement variants, family rubrics, privileged likelihood context, hint generation and shared model-facing messages. Dataset content and discoverable proposer/recorder skills remain in their original release locations.

deepswe_table_layout.change: Non-breaking hyphens in model/strategy display names and non-breaking spaces in table headings and judge-effort labels; numeric values and colored deltas unchanged.

deepswe_table_layout.probe_scope: Layout probe used equivalent inline numeric text in place of MathJax; regression tests verify the original numeric math expressions remain unchanged. No GPU model or paid API experiment was run.

direct_execution.training_test: Temporary shell stubs record the Ray and training commands; no Ray cluster or GPU training interpreter is launched.

All five existing release checks passed.

discovered_strategy_naming.compatibility: Legacy Strategy6 spelling is normalized before argument validation; it is no longer advertised. Internal discovered setting, c006_r0 strategy identifier and execution behavior remain unchanged.
discovered_strategy_naming.scope: README, prompt guide, parameter reference, CLI help/listing and parser compatibility. No GPU or model jobs run.

scaffold_naming.compatibility: Only exact explicit scaffold names are accepted; the normalization function and legacy alias mapping were removed. Resume requires matching names and leaves existing records unchanged. Older output labels require a new output directory.
scaffold_naming.checks: Source tests cover CLI and direct-call rejection before execution, all scaffold modes, canonical resume without repeating completed tasks, and mismatched resume without rewriting results. Pylint correctness checks, English-only scan, and strict sdist/wheel metadata checks passed. Installed-wheel imports, selector names, candidate counts, parser choices, and three CLI checks passed outside the checkout.
scaffold_naming.scope: Implementation names and input/resume validation only; generation, judge, and privileged-scoring behavior preserved. Raw experimental records and upstream provenance paths remain unchanged. Rejected names appear only in negative regression fixtures, not runtime aliases. No GPU, model, sandbox, or benchmark jobs were run.

unified_harness.coverage: All named settings, including DeepSWE Standard/SJ, use the shared loop. Full SJ and Discovered share SelfGuideRubrics. Benchmark-specific grading contracts remain explicit.
unified_harness.checks: 99 CPU-only offline tests passed. Added coverage for complete multi-tool batches, cwd prompts, strict submission, retained history, external judge parameters/authentication, precise weights, identical/tied selection, DeepSWE in-place grading, bundled DeepSWE gold, infrastructure accounting, protocol resume guards and failure retry. Correctness lint and strict distribution metadata checks passed.
unified_harness.package_check: Built source distribution and wheel; installed the wheel into a temporary environment outside the checkout. All 17 named settings resolve to the shared protocol; 500 Verified, 731 Pro, 1231 combined, 113 DeepSWE and 192 validation tasks load. DeepSWE SJ gold loading verified with a mocked dispatcher.
unified_harness.experiments: No model, GPU or benchmark experiments were run for this refactor. Final regression tests use mocked model/HTTP/sandbox operations.
unified_harness.historical_results: Paper table values and raw archived records were not modified or rerun. Historical mixed harnesses are documented in docs/HARNESS.md and paper_data/README.md; old outputs cannot be resumed as unified runs.
unified_harness.accounting: Infrastructure failures remain in the fixed expected-trial denominator but are not counted as valid completed trials or solves. Summaries stay provisional and exclude incomplete trials from turn statistics; resume retries failures.

Historical paper measurements and their original subset files are unchanged.

verification.ci: Existing unittest discovery includes the new checks. Installed-wheel assertions also require 731 Pro / 1231 combined tasks.

The visualization repository also retains 13 additional archives and the original visualization commit history.

former_main_viewer.note: The old local viewer was removed from main; its exact source remains in this SI2CA Git commit. Use the maintained viewer in SI2CA-Visualization.

research_archive.runtime_inputs: Main retains data/bench1231.jsonl, data/deepswe113.jsonl, data/dev192_multilingual.jsonl, data/assets.tar.gz, and the benchmark manifest and method-figure assets.

legacy_runtime_cleanup.scope: Remove unused historical drivers and their private helper graph from main. Public CLI/API entry points, standalone scripts, dynamically loaded training plugins, benchmark inputs, prompt assets, and raw research records are retained.
legacy_runtime_cleanup.references: The unified runner imports the standalone grading adapter. Tests now exercise the active judge, selector weights, window helper, and prompt assets directly, without importing removed legacy drivers. The unused branch_config exporter is removed.
legacy_runtime_cleanup.dependency_audit: All 139 remaining Python files were inspected. No unreachable implementation module remains after accounting for documented CLI/script entry points, package initializer side effects, and string-based training loaders.

Public CLI help, run help, method/skill listing and data preparation passed; 500 Verified, 731 Pro, 1231 combined, 113 DeepSWE and 192 validation tasks load.
